book: Technic and Magic: The Reconstruction of Reality (Federico Campagna)
best_collision: c02017 (Technic demands no obedience — it demands an ontological mutation, the most profound border control) complicates c02013 (presence is the prime object of production and policing) @0.6933: the policeable target is not your presence, it is your species
quote: Conversely, Technic demands no obedience – indeed, it doesn't demand anything. Technic's cosmology sets a filter that allows access to a status of legitimate presence in the world, only to those who have undergone a fundamental mutation in their ontological structure. (p.45)
mutation_note: The 20th century demanded you stand to attention; this century demands you stop being what you were. The epidemic is the price of the surgery: anxiety, depression, suicide, mass murder — what the unmutated do when they refuse the operation. And the flat Earth is the tell: we all know the world is limited and has an edge, so we blame the ancients for not knowing it.
